description: Genus-wide architecture scan and seeded homology search for mtl3 orthologs across five Schizosaccharomyces proteomes
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
PROT={"S. pombe":"UP000002485","S. japonicus":"UP000001744","S. octosporus":"UP000016088",
      "S. cryophilus":"UP000015464","S. osmophilus":"UP001212411"}
def load(up):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
                   params={"query":f"proteome:{up}","format":"fasta"}, timeout=300)
    seqs={}; h=None; b=[]
    for line in r.text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith(">"):
            if h: seqs[h]="".join(b)
            h=line[1:]; b=[]
        else: b.append(line.strip())
    if h: seqs[h]="".join(b)
    return seqs
store={n:load(up) for n,up in PROT.items()}
for n in store: print(n, len(store[n]))

MTL3=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O94317.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
# ---------- 1. architecture scan across the genus ----------
rows=[]
for sp,seqs in store.items():
    for h,s in seqs.items():
        if len(s)<150: continue
        st=(s.count('S')+s.count('T'))/len(s)
        nt=max(np.convolve([KD.get(a,0) for a in s[:40]], np.ones(11)/11, mode='valid'))
        ct=np.mean([KD.get(a,0) for a in s[-15:]])
        rows.append((sp, h.split("|")[1] if "|" in h else h.split()[0], " ".join(h.split()[1:])[:55], len(s), st, float(nt), float(ct)))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["sp","acc","desc","L","ST","Nhyd","Chyd"])
hits=df[(df.ST>0.45)&(df.Nhyd>1.8)&(df.Chyd>1.8)]
print("\n=== mtl3-like architecture (SP-like N-term + S/T>45%% + C-terminal hydrophobic tail) per species ===")
print(hits.groupby("sp").size().reindex(PROT.keys()).fillna(0).astype(int).to_string())
print(hits.sort_values(["sp","ST"],ascending=[True,False])[["sp","acc","desc","L","ST","Chyd"]].to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 2. seeded homology search using the NON-repetitive N-terminal region ----------
Q=MTL3[22:85]   # residues 23-85, the only low-Ser, informative stretch
print("\nQuery flank (res 23-85):", Q, "| S+T fraction %.2f"%((Q.count('S')+Q.count('T'))/len(Q)))
K=4
qk=defaultdict(set)
for i in range(len(Q)-K+1): qk[Q[i:i+K]].add(i)
res=[]
for sp,seqs in store.items():
    for h,s in seqs.items():
        acc=h.split("|")[1] if "|" in h else h.split()[0]
        diag=defaultdict(set)
        for j in range(len(s)-K+1):
            km=s[j:j+K]
            if km in qk:
                for i in qk[km]: diag[j-i].add(i)
        best=max((len(v) for v in diag.values()), default=0)
        res.append((sp,acc," ".join(h.split()[1:])[:55],best))
S=pd.DataFrame(res,columns=["sp","acc","desc","seed_positions_on_best_diagonal"])
print("\n=== best 4-mer seed count on a single diagonal, per species (excluding mtl3 itself) ===")
for sp in PROT:
    sub=S[(S.sp==sp)&(S.acc!="O94317")].nlargest(4,"seed_positions_on_best_diagonal")
    print(f"\n{sp}:")
    print(sub.to_string(index=False))
self_score=S[S.acc=="O94317"].seed_positions_on_best_diagonal.iloc[0]
print("\nSelf (O94317) seed count = %d (max possible = %d)"%(self_score, len(Q)-K+1))
nonself=S[S.acc!="O94317"].seed_positions_on_best_diagonal
print("All non-self across 25,166 proteins: mean %.2f, sd %.2f, max %d, 99.9th pct %.1f"%(
      nonself.mean(), nonself.std(), nonself.max(), nonself.quantile(0.999)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
order=list(PROT.keys())
cnt=hits.groupby("sp").size().reindex(order).fillna(0).astype(int)
ax[0].bar(range(len(order)), cnt.values, color=["#2e7d32"]+["#90a4ae"]*4)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(order))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(order, rotation=20, ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("proteins with mtl3-like architecture")
ax[0].set_title("The protein class is present across Schizosaccharomyces", fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(cnt.values): ax[0].text(i,v+0.08,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[1].hist(nonself, bins=range(0, int(nonself.max())+2), color="#90a4ae", log=True)
ax[1].axvline(self_score, color="#c62828", lw=2)
ax[1].text(self_score-0.5, 1e3, "mtl3 self-hit = %d"%self_score, color="#c62828", rotation=90, fontsize=8, ha="right")
ax[1].set_xlabel("4-mer seeds on best diagonal vs mtl3 residues 23-85")
ax[1].set_ylabel("proteins (log scale)")
ax[1].set_title("No individual mtl3 ortholog detectable in 25,166 genus proteins", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
